findings.title: Fallback calendar lookup is always empty or tautological
findings.body: This branch only runs when `externalCalendarId` is falsy. The `find` then compares `cal.externalId === externalCalendarId`, which never matches a real id. `selectedCalendar` ends up undefined, and the old fallback to the destination calendar is lost. Use the main host's destination calendar externalId instead. The same bug is in `deleteEvent`.

findings.title: Null deref when destinationCalendar is empty
findings.body: `mainHostDestinationCalendar` is undefined when `destinationCalendar` is null or empty. Accessing `.integration` without `?.` then throws a TypeError. Bookings with no destination calendar are common. The old code used `?.`. Use `mainHostDestinationCalendar?.integration`.

findings.title: Slug logic inverted
findings.body: The old code set `slug` when billing was NOT enabled and `requestedSlug` when it was enabled. The new code reverses this. The change is unrelated to the PR and breaks organization creation. Revert it.

findings.title: deleteEvent fallback never finds a calendar
findings.body: The fallback only runs when `externalCalendarId` is falsy, and then it searches for a calendar whose externalId equals that falsy value. It always yields undefined, so the delete goes to "primary" and ignores the destination calendar. Use the first destination calendar's externalId.

findings.title: Team destination calendars dropped when host has none
findings.body: `evt.destinationCalendar` can be null when neither the event type nor the organizer has a destination calendar. In that case `?.push` does nothing and the collective hosts' calendars are silently dropped. Initialize `evt.destinationCalendar` to an array and then push.

findings.title: Destination calendar chosen by credentialId only
findings.body: `createEvent` is now called with `credential.id`. If a destination calendar has no credentialId, or the fallback path calls `createEvent` for a credential without a matching destination calendar, the code falls to "primary". The old code used the destination calendar's externalId. Legacy destination calendars without a credentialId lose their target calendar.

findings.title: credentialId for non-calendar results dropped
findings.body: The old code returned `result.credentialId` for non-calendar types. The new code returns undefined, so video and other references lose their credentialId. Later updates and deletes depend on it.

findings.title: Fallback createEvent calls omit externalId
findings.body: When a destination has no credentialId, `createEvent(c, event)` is called without an externalId. The booking reference then gets an undefined externalCalendarId, even though the destination calendar had one. The same applies to the no-destination fallback.

findings.title: Unrelated loadUsers rewrite changes behavior
findings.body: The rewrite is unrelated to the request. It drops the `organization: { select: { slug } }` from the dynamic user query. It also wraps errors and turns any unexpected error into a 500. It throws for an empty dynamicUserList, where the old code would return no users and fail later.
